topic: dispose of old rechargeable batteries safely
core_question: How should I get rid of old rechargeable batteries instead of throwing them in the trash? (secondary: How do you adjust bike brakes that feel weak or spongy and aren't stopping well?)
answer_summary: Bring old rechargeable (and lithium) batteries to a designated recycling drop-off, such as a hardware/electronics store collection bin, rather than the regular trash.; after the topic shift: Loosen the cable anchor bolt, pull the slack out of the brake cable so the pads sit close to the rim, retighten the anchor bolt, and check pad alignment so they strike the rim evenly.
